title: iris kurdica
intro: Iris kurdica, commonly known as Kurdish iris, is a plant species belonging to the iris family and native to the mountainous regions of Iraq and Turkey. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Iris kurdica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that exert anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial activities. These bioactive compounds have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in wound healing, pain management, and the treatment of various infectious diseases.
